Hymn 262: Go, Ye Messengers of Glory
Time Signature: 4/4
Musical Key: D Major
Composer: Tracy Y. Cannon
Lyricist/Text Author: John Taylor
Category: Special Topics

This is hymn number 262 titled "Go, Ye Messengers of Glory" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in D Major with a 4/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by Tracy Y. Cannon and the lyrics were written by John Taylor.
